title: STQA-01 Repeated header search activation leaves focus on the link
body:
## New
On the original Nebo baseline (SPA commit `c66699f916dc3fdfb44e0713af9ab0c53f4204ff`), open the homepage in Chrome. Focus the header Search perfumes link and press Enter. The catalog input receives focus. Focus the header link again and press Enter a second time.

**Expected:** Focus returns to the catalog search input on each activation so typing can begin immediately.

**Actual:** On the second activation the catalog input remains inactive. Keyboard users must navigate to the field manually. The new Playwright case STQA-01 reproduced the failure on the baseline.

**Severity:** Medium. **Priority:** P2. **Area:** Catalog keyboard interaction.

comments.body:
## Fixed
Commit [55fe1bf](https://github.com/Saiyaf-Sdk/STQA/commit/55fe1bff0af5b1e53fcd891b6d5e7e9d79a0bbbf) focuses the search field when the header link is activated on the current catalog view and preserves existing query and filter parameters. The existing route watcher handles arrival from other views. The original defect reproduced in the baseline Playwright run.

## Verified
The original regression and the complete QA suite passed in the [push-triggered verification run](https://github.com/Saiyaf-Sdk/STQA/actions/runs/45420909420). The field received keyboard focus on repeated activation and retained the existing search term. The local Chrome run also passed all 15 Playwright cases.

## Closed
Resolution confirmed by regression testing.
